verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general LLM tool use that a developer can use to look up data for RAG. That is a building block for constructing retrieval, not a documented built-in knowledge base or document-grounding feature. No first-party document ingestion, indexing or retrieval capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content

citations.quote: Call external APIs or lookup data for RAG.
